title: Little Sophia doll used to map children's brains in Africa

tellings.quote: Yeah. And doll a doll called little Sophia. This ass doll. Like to make him think about STEM.

plain: A doll called Little Sophia was, in this story, handed to children in Africa as a way to map their brains, sold under the idea of getting kids to think about science and technology. Kurt Metzger, a guest on an episode about the financier Jeffrey Epstein, tells it as something he was told by someone else, calling it "this ass doll" meant "to make him think about STEM", a term for science, technology, engineering and maths. He brings it up as a sign of hidden projects aimed at children's minds.
